title: Process Optimization Partner
description:
About the Role


The Process Optimization Partner plays a key role in transforming the People Team’s operations through technology, automation, and intelligent systems. You’ll analyse workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable solutions that enhance the employee and stakeholder experience. This role blends strategic problem-solving with hands-on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.


Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, document, and improve People Team workflows across the employee lifecycle (recruiting, onboarding, development, engagement, and offboarding).
  • Identify automation opportunities using tools like Zapier, Workato, Power Automate, or internal HRIS systems.
  • Partner with HR stakeholders to reduce manual work, streamline approvals, and improve process accuracy.
  • Implement and monitor AI-driven workflows that enhance response times and reduce operational bottlenecks.
  • Design and maintain AI-powered chatbots to handle routine HR and general support inquiries, FAQs, and employee self-service needs.
  • Continuously analyse chatbot performance to improve accuracy, tone, and efficiency using feedback loops and analytics.
  • Collaborate with IT and data teams to ensure proper integration between HR systems and conversational AI platforms.
  • Build and manage a centralized HR knowledge base that supports employees, managers, and the People Team.
  • Develop structured documentation practices to ensure consistency and ease of information retrieval.
  • Implement taxonomy and tagging systems that enable quick search and smart recommendations.
  • Define and track key metrics related to process efficiency, automation adoption, and employee experience.
  • Use data and feedback to prioritize initiatives and communicate impact to leadership.
  • Stay current on emerging HR technologies, AI trends, and automation best practices.


Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in HR operations, process improvement, or business automation.
  • Strong understanding of HR workflows, systems, and employee experience design.
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Boomi, etc.) and/or AI assistants or chatbot builders (e.g. ChatGPT Enterprise, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (HiBob, Workday, or similar).
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to translate strategy into execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and analytical mindset.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Hubspot CRM.
  • Exposure to AI prompt engineering, knowledge management, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Passion for creating intuitive, efficient, and employee-friendly systems.


Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The People Team operates with greater speed, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Employees and managers can easily find answers through AI chatbots and a robust knowledge base.
  • Manual, repetitive tasks are reduced or eliminated through automation.
  • Continuous improvement becomes a core capability of the People function.

title: Arquiteto/Desenvolvedor Sênior Power Platform
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções complexas utilizando a Microsoft Power Platform, incluindo Power Apps, Power Automate, e Power BI.
  • Liderar a arquitetura de novos projetos, garantindo a escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência das soluções.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para identificar formas de integrar a Power Platform com outras tecnologias e sistemas corporativos.
  • Conduzir workshops e treinamentos para equipes internas, promovendo a adoção e o uso eficaz da Power Platform.
  • Fornecer liderança técnica e mentoria para desenvolvedores juniores e plenos.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as últimas tendências e atualizações da Microsoft Power Platform e incorporá-las nas soluções desenvolvidas.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como arquiteto/desenvolvedor sênior na Microsoft Power Platform.
  • Habilidade para projetar soluções complexas e experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicativos e automatizações com a Power Platform.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em segurança de dados, conformidade e melhores práticas da Microsoft.
  • Experiência em linguagens como JavaScript, .NET e C# será um diferencial.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação em inglês, tanto verbal quanto escrita.
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos e trabalhar de forma independente e proativa.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações Microsoft relacionadas à Power Platform.
  • Experiência em trabalhar em projetos internacionais.


Idiomas: Fluência em Inglês é obrigatória

title: Senior Full Stack Developer, Healthcare and Factory Automation
description:
We are a US startup company headquartered in New York City (


We deliver innovative applications and data solutions to consumers and enterprises. Our projects typically include social, financial, gaming, and shopping elements.


We are looking for highly talented, motivated, and responsible engineers. We value people who are able to understand business needs and solve difficult problems, as well as people who are willing to learn new things and take responsibility for delivering great results.


We provide an exciting environment with others who share a passion for excellence. Come meet us and see for yourself if you want to join a growing international business.


Position: Senior Full Stack Developer, Healthcare and Factory Automation


Work on the next generation of healthcare and factory automation applications and services powered by AI and excellent experiences. Join a team of experienced startup developers building out highly scalable service architectures to radically change the status quo in healthcare and factory automation.


Desirable technology experience:

● Python / Go

● gRPC / Protocol Buffers

● React.js / React Native / Vue

● PostgreSQL / SQL Server

● AWS serverless technologies: Lambda, SQS, SNS, etc.

● Applications of LLM and ML AI technologies


Desirable subject matter expertise:

Healthcare and factory automation. Experience with other insurance markets. Fintech, particularly trading and portfolio applications for financial advisors and their investors.


Minimum Applicant Requirements:

● Excellent command of English, written and spoken

● Ability to produce tested applications from business requirements

● Ability to work independently and as a team member

● Self-starting, well-organized, and enthusiastic work style

● At least 8+ years of working experience in relevant technologies


Additional requirements:

This position requires a background check of your work and life experience by a 3rd party.


Benefits:

● Competitive compensation

● Flexible work/life balance

● Work with the latest technologies

● Work with a small, intense, and fun team


Applicant Questions

SUBMISSIONS WITHOUT ANSWERS TO THESE QUESTIONS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED:

If you are interested in the position, please compose a written introduction to yourself in the English language, including answers to the questions below, as well as anything else we should know, and send it along with your resume.


  • When can you start?
  • How many years have you worked full-time as a Full Stack Developer?
  • What hourly rate do you charge for full-time contract jobs?
  • Please write a paragraph about your favorite past project. Be sure to tell us why you liked it.


Due to the number of applications from fake identities, you will be required to present an ID (Passport or Driver’s License) sufficient to verify your identity at the beginning of your first interview.

title: AI Agent Developer Jr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Analista de Automação de IA Jr

Contratação CLT


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com mão na massa e experiência prática comprovada em ferramentas de automação e integração para atuar na criação de agentes inteligentes e fluxos com IA generativa. Essa vaga é ideal para quem já colocou automações no ar, conhece ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, APIs REST e está em busca de um ambiente onde possa evoluir criando soluções reais com impacto direto no negócio.

Você irá contribuir na construção e evolução de agentes em um time estratégico e conectado com a área de Produtos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Mapear processos repetitivos e oportunidades de automação utilizando IA e integrações inteligentes.
  • Criar, configurar e manter agentes operacionais integrados a ferramentas como Microsoft Teams, Jira, Supabase e WhatsApp.
  • Desenvolver automações robustas e reutilizáveis com ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Conectar APIs e Webhooks para promover fluxos dinâmicos entre sistemas.
  • Aplicar IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) para automatizar decisões, gerar conteúdo e criar experiências personalizadas.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das automações e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender dores reais e traduzir em soluções operacionais com IA.
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança e governança de dados nas integrações.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia em automações no ar com pelo menos uma das ferramentas: N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Familiaridade com integrações via APIs REST e Webhooks.
  • Noções de bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (ex: Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB).
  • Conhecimento introdutório ou prático em IA generativa e uso de modelos como ChatGPT.
  • Organização, curiosidade, boa comunicação e autonomia para aprender fazendo.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e entregar soluções com qualidade, mesmo em contextos de baixa complexidade.


Diferenciais

  • Já ter desenvolvido bots ou agentes internos, mesmo em projetos pessoais ou freelas.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Teams Bot Framework ou WhatsApp Business API.
  • Noções de Machine Learning, fluxos com NLP ou experiências com LLMs.
  • Participação em projetos de transformação digital ou hackathons.
  • Conhecimento em documentação técnica e lógica de versionamento (ex: ReadMe, Notion, Git).

O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Analista de Automação de IA Jr

Contratação CLT


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com mão na massa e experiência prática comprovada em ferramentas de automação e integração para atuar na criação de agentes inteligentes e fluxos com IA generativa. Essa vaga é ideal para quem já colocou automações no ar, conhece ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, APIs REST e está em busca de um ambiente onde possa evoluir criando soluções reais com impacto direto no negócio.

Você irá contribuir na construção e evolução de agentes em um time estratégico e conectado com a área de Produtos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Mapear processos repetitivos e oportunidades de automação utilizando IA e integrações inteligentes.
  • Criar, configurar e manter agentes operacionais integrados a ferramentas como Microsoft Teams, Jira, Supabase e WhatsApp.
  • Desenvolver automações robustas e reutilizáveis com ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Conectar APIs e Webhooks para promover fluxos dinâmicos entre sistemas.
  • Aplicar IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) para automatizar decisões, gerar conteúdo e criar experiências personalizadas.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das automações e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender dores reais e traduzir em soluções operacionais com IA.
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança e governança de dados nas integrações.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia em automações no ar com pelo menos uma das ferramentas: N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Familiaridade com integrações via APIs REST e Webhooks.
  • Noções de bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (ex: Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB).
  • Conhecimento introdutório ou prático em IA generativa e uso de modelos como ChatGPT.
  • Organização, curiosidade, boa comunicação e autonomia para aprender fazendo.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e entregar soluções com qualidade, mesmo em contextos de baixa complexidade.


Diferenciais

  • Já ter desenvolvido bots ou agentes internos, mesmo em projetos pessoais ou freelas.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Teams Bot Framework ou WhatsApp Business API.
  • Noções de Machine Learning, fluxos com NLP ou experiências com LLMs.
  • Participação em projetos de transformação digital ou hackathons.
  • Conhecimento em documentação técnica e lógica de versionamento (ex: ReadMe, Notion, Git).

Ambiente dinâmico e diverso

Home Office

WellHub (gympass)

Convênio médico

Convênio odonto

VR/VA em cartão flexível

title: Vendedor(a) de Cloud Services
description:
Estamos crescendo e precisamos de você!

Somos um provedor de serviços de nuvem inovador e estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Vendedora de Cloud talentosa para impulsionar o nosso crescimento. Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, tem experiência em vendas B2B e busca trabalhar de forma remota, esta oportunidade é para você!


Você será responsável por:

  • Prospecção ativa e qualificação de oportunidades.
  • Conduzir reuniões de “discovery” e diagnóstico com os clientes.
  • Com apoio do time técnico, desenhar a solução ideal de nuvem.
  • Elaborar e apresentar propostas comerciais personalizadas.
  • Negociar e fechar contratos.
  • Acompanhar o relacionamento pós-venda.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas de serviços de TI e/ou nuvem.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem, segurança e migração.
  • Habilidades de comunicação e negociação excepcionais.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto (home office).

O que Oferecemos:

  • Remuneração: Salário mensal compatível com o mercado + comissão sobre o valor de cada contrato vendido (potencial ilimitado!).
  • Benefícios: Seguro de vida em grupo, plano de saúde Unimed nacional sem coparticipação e vale alimentação ou refeição (Pluxee).
  • Ferramentas de trabalho: Laptop e celular corporativo fornecidos pela empresa.
  • Regime: CLT (carteira assinada).
  • Modalidade de trabalho: Remoto em tempo integral.
  • Horário de trabalho: Das 8h às 12h | 13h30 às 18h

Se você busca impulsionar a carreira e fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica, participe do processo seletivo!

title: Propulsion Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage in close collaboration with stakeholders from various teams to gather in-depth insights into the requirements and objectives of the vehicle. Work closely with cross-functional teams, including electrical and software engineers to ensure seamless integration of the propulsion systems.
  • Propulsion System Development: Apply advanced engineering principles and methodologies to create propulsion solutions that are recognized for their reliability, efficiency, and high performance. Take the lead in chairing meetings with stakeholders, actively listen to their concerns, facilitate productive discussions, and collaborate towards resolving any issues collectively. Additionally, prepare and deliver comprehensive presentations to the leadership team, highlighting the significant progress and achievements attained during the propulsion system development process.
  • Network and Electrical Drawings: Leverage your technical proficiency and attention to detail to generate accurate and comprehensive communication and System Electrical Drawings for all vehicles and all phases like mules, protos, production etc. These deliverables will serve as essential references throughout the engineering process, facilitating effective communication, troubleshooting, and maintenance of the propulsion systems.
  • Propulsion System 12V Load Budget: Possess technical expertise and knowledge to develop accurate and detailed specifications for the 12V load budget deliverable for Electric Powertrain projects and its components to ensure safe and reliable operation of the electrical system.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or any other related field.
  • Minimum 5-8 years of experience in Electrical/Electronics/Automotive field
  • Strong understanding of engineering cost and time implications.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, enabling effective interaction with stakeholders across different teams.
  • In-depth knowledge of engineering principles.
  • Analytic mindset and problem-solving abilities to address complex engineering challenges.
  • Passion for innovation and drive to contribute to cutting-edge projects in automotive industry.
  • Familiar with the Agile-Scrum methodology and the associated concepts of planning
  • Sound knowledge of CAN and LIN components (HW/SW)
  • Capable of creating Logical as well as Physical Schematics
  • Experience with Microsoft Visio, Excel, Word and Power Point
  • Highly motivated/self starter with proven leadership skills

title: Software Engineer Sênior Golang
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?


A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton, Vitta e Collact, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.


Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Especialista em IA Generativa
description:
Especialista em IA Generativa (LLMs)

Modelo: 100% Remoto

Modelo de Contratação: CLT


Venha construir o futuro da IA com um dos líderes em tecnologia do Brasil!

Junte-se ao Escritório de Projetos em Inteligência Artificial e lidere iniciativas com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs), frameworks de agentes como CrewAI e Llama-Index, e soluções de ponta em RAG.


Descrição do Cargo:

1) Desenvolver e avaliar soluções baseadas em LLMs, incluindo pipelines com RAG e frameworks como CrewAI e Llama-Index.

2) Medir o desempenho de modelos e agentes com métricas, testes A/B e abordagens como LLM-as-a-judge.

3) Contribuir na arquitetura técnica e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo boas práticas em engenharia de IA.


Requisitos:

1) Formação superior completa (desejável mestrado na área) e sólida experiência com LLMs e técnicas de RAG.

2) Conhecimento prático em frameworks de agentes como CrewAI, Llama-Index ou similares.

3) Vivência na avaliação de LLMs (quantitativa e qualitativa), incluindo uso de LLMs as a judge

3) Experiência com Docker, pipelines de ETL, ambientes produtivos e liderança técnica.

4) Inglês Intermediário

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Estamos com uma oportunidade para o nosso time corporativo para: Engenheiro(a) Dados Sênior


Inglês Fluente

  • 5 a 7 anos em desenvolvimento de aplicações de BI.
  • Atuação com gestão de configuração e liberação, testes de integração e levantamento de requisitos.
  • Identificação de riscos técnicos e de segurança com proposição de mitigação.
  • Proposição de melhorias operacionais e de boas práticas.

Competências Técnicas Obrigatórias:

  • Azure Data Services: Data Lake, Data Factory, Synapse, Functions, Key Vault.
  • Databricks: Pipelines, notebooks (Python/Scala), transformação e otimização Spark.
  • DevOps: CI/CD com Azure DevOps e Git.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Conceitos de Data Lakehouse, Delta Lake e tuning de performance.
  • DataOps: Monitoramento, qualidade, logging e alertas.
  • Proficiência em Python e SQL .
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas distribuídas e formatos de dados (Parquet, Avro, JSON).

Competências Desejáveis:

  • Comunicação eficaz com times internacionais.
  • Experiência nos setores industrial, automotivo ou logístico.
  • Vivência com equipes europeias.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas legados como ICS (Informatica ID).

Soft Skills:

  • Trabalho colaborativo com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Autonomia, liderança técnica e mentoring.
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas e melhorias de qualidade.
  • Inglês avançado.


Modelo de trabalho:


  • Remoto: Home office - 100%.

title: Software Engineer (Python/ML)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,500 - $7,500 USD


Our partner assists lenders in unblocking their underwriting bottleneck at scale. This is accomplished through a novel approach with a modern Rules-based Distributed System that constantly reacts and updates according to a variety of stimuli.


Do you like Functional Programming? Great, they do too. That’s why Clojure is a first-class citizen in their stack. How about Machine Learning? Great. They are building classification models to classify documents and extract data to automate the mortgage process. They have combined Clojure, Machine Learning, and Google to form a sophisticated lending document platform.


They are a remote-first company and believe that open communication and effective teamwork can happen regardless of where you work.


What you’ll do:

  • Contribute to the design, architecture, and development of their Document Management,
  • classification and extraction platform
  • Work on applications in Clojure, Java, and Python
  • Work on frontend code with JavaScript and Svelte
  • Manage Machine Learning workloads with TensorFlow and Google Doc AI tools
  • Work with their DevOps team on their autoscaling Containers running in ECS and managed through Terraform


Who you are:

  • 6+ years of experience as a software developer with Python and ML experience
  • 3+ years of experience with TensorFlow
  • You are pragmatic and factor business value into every decision
  • Enjoy being a part of a team
  • Rock-solid communication skills
  • Comfortable working in Clojure or Java
  • Experienced with distributed microservice architectures


Bonus points for experience with:

  • Financial technology
  • AI / Expert Systems
  • AWS / Terraform


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Consultor de VBA
description:
Consultor de VBA – Remoto


Modelo de contratação: PJ


A UPBI Data & AI , consultoria especializada em soluções digitais e parceira Microsoft e Databricks, está em busca de um Consultor de VBA para atuar no desenvolvimento de automações e soluções customizadas utilizando Excel e ferramentas Microsoft. Buscamos um profissional com perfil analítico, inovador e com experiência em projetos de consultoria, capaz de entender as necessidades do negócio e traduzir demandas em soluções eficientes.


Responsabilidades:


• Desenvolver macros e automações utilizando VBA (Visual Basic for Applications) para Excel e demais ferramentas Microsoft

• Criar, otimizar e manter planilhas, rotinas automáticas, relatórios e dashboards operacionais

• Realizar integração de aplicativos do Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Access, PowerPoint)

• Automatizar processos manuais e apoiar áreas na melhoria de performance de controles e indicadores

• Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas às necessidades do cliente

• Documentar soluções desenvolvidas e prestar suporte técnico às áreas usuárias


Requisitos indispensáveis:


• Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento VBA

• Excel avançado (incluindo fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas e estruturação de dados)

• Experiência em automação de processos e construção de relatórios

• Vivência em consultoria ou atuação em interface com áreas de negócio

• Capacidade de análise de requisitos e entendimento de necessidades operacionais


Diferenciais:


• Conhecimento em Power Automate e Power Apps

• Experiência com integração de dados

• Noções de SQL ou análise de dados

• Inglês intermediário ou superior

title: Senior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. This isn't just about coding, it's about leading technical initiatives, mentoring rising talent, and solving complex challenges using Python's powerful ecosystem while driving innovation in cloud environments, data processing, and web development.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Develop data integration services that accelerate customer onboarding processes.

- Ensure reliability, performance, and support of data infrastructure with solutions aligned to application needs and growth projections.

- Lead the design and implementation of complex Python applications.

- Guide junior developers through comprehensive code reviews and technical mentoring.

- Architect scalable solutions using modern design patterns and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into technical specifications.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL Databases.

- Experience with Microservices and Cloud environments.

- Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Strong understanding of best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns knowledge.

- Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Experience in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong experience with version control.

- Strong experience with Unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage.

- Advanced English proficiency.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Pessoa Técnica de Gasoduto I
description:
A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção (ESOM) é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG, a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.




Missão do cargo

Atuar na manutenção mecânica, elétrica, preditiva, preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos bem como participar de manobras de campo de controle manual de equipamentos e operação de estações de gás.




Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Executar diariamente o plano de manutenção mecânica/elétrica na sua área de atuação, em ações, preditivas, preventivas e corretivas em válvulas, sistema de compressão, sistema de segurança, bombas, sensores e outros pertencentes ao gasoduto e suas instalações atendendo a uma programação definida pelo superior ou conforme solicitação de serviço;
  • Coletar os dados técnicos obtidos através de equipamentos e instrumentos em campo;
  • Participar de serviços para desmontar o equipamento, revisar ou reparar o defeito, substituir peças, tornar a montar e testar o serviço realizado, junto com os Técnicos III e Supervisores, para efeitos de treinamento;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios operacionais e técnicos dos serviços de manutenção;
  • Atuar em situações emergenciais, contendo problemas técnicos como vazamentos, interrupções de operações ou outros que podem tornar o gasoduto indisponível.




Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Formação: Curso técnico de nível médio completo (Mecânica e Eletromecânica);
  • Registros e Certificações: CNH válido, na categoria “B”;
  • Experiência/ Conhecimento com Operação e Manutenção, Automação e Instrumentação e/ou Mecânica.




Local de Trabalho

Camaçari - BA - Brasil

title: "engenheiro machine learning#984005"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de validação de dados e avaliação de modelos em ambiente cloud (AWS).
  • Integrar dados e métricas de avaliação em um fluxo automatizado e auditável.
  • Modularizar o pipeline para facilitar reuso, testes e manutenção.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com times de Data Science, Engenharia de Dados e Produto.
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, logging, monitoramento e testes automatizados.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas na arquitetura de dados e nos processos de validação.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida com engenharia de software aplicada a dados e machine learning.
  • Proficiência em Python e frameworks como PySpark, Pandas, Scikit-learn ou similares.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e serviços AWS, como S3, Lambda, Step Functions, Glue, Athena, SageMaker ou ECS.
  • Conhecimento em MLOps e CI/CD para pipelines de dados e modelos.
  • Experiência com orquestração de workflows.
  • Capacidade de escrever código limpo, modular e testável.


Resumo da posição.

  • Trabalho Remoto
  • Contratação CLT
  • Projeto de 5 a 11 meses

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Metrobi is a VC-backed startup and an alumni of Techstars Boston, one of the leading accelerators in the USA.


We power deliveries for local food and beverage businesses in Boston, New York, DC, Chicago, LA, and other major metropolitan areas. Our technology is at the center of our delivery marketplace.


Intro video:


Why should you join Metrobi?

  • Play a key role in shaping performance marketing strategy.
  • Fast-paced, growth-oriented environment with plenty of room to test & learn.
  • Opportunity to directly impact conversions and revenue.
  • International team experience and a supportive work environment.
  • A well-funded company that offers competitive compensation.
  • An opportunity to learn every day in a fast-paced environment.
  • A chance to become a part of a dynamic company on a fast track to change the logistics scene in the US.


About the role

We’re looking for a data-driven Digital Marketing Specialist who loves experimenting, optimizing, and scaling growth. If you enjoy working with WordPress and creating compelling content for emails and landing pages, this role is for you.


  • Professional English Proficiency is a must.
  • Hiring interviews will be conducted online.


What you’ll do:

  • Build and iterate on landing pages (WordPress + Elementor), testing buttons, hero texts, CTAs, and layouts.
  • Run A/B tests & experiments to improve conversion rates continuously.
  • Track, analyze, and report performance.
  • Understand the audience and work on improving the copy from email marketing campaigns.


What we’re looking for:

  • Strong knowledge of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and A/B testing.
  • An analytical marketing mindset, while being quick to iterate on ideas.
  • Creative problem solver who thrives on experimentation and iteration.
  • Hands-on experience with WordPress & Elementor.
  • Experience with creating content for emails and or landing pages


Nice to have:

  • SEO basics
  • Basic HTML/CSS
  • Understanding of UI/UX principles for better user journeys.
  • Experience with Google Ads / Meta Ads / LinkedIn Ads
  • Familiarity with Google Sheets


  • This is a remote position.
  • Must be able to work between (9AM-6PM EST)

title: ITSM FreshService Engineer
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


Title: ITSM FreshService Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Contract: 12+ Months


We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive ITSM Engineer with proven experience in Freshservice to lead and optimize our IT service management platform. This role is critical in driving operational excellence, enhancing user experience, and aligning service delivery with business needs.

This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote India or Brazil. At Cepheid, our vision is to be the leading provider of seamlessly connected diagnostic solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Freshservice Platform Ownership

  • Configure, customize, and maintain Freshservice modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, and Service Catalog.
  • Implement automation workflows, SLAs, and integrations with other enterprise tools.


Process Optimization & Governance

  • Design and refine ITSM processes aligned with ITIL best practices.
  • Ensure compliance, consistency, and continuous improvement across service management operations.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Collaborate with service desk, infrastructure, and application teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
  • Provide training and support to end-users and internal teams on Freshservice usage and enhancements.


Reporting & Insights

  • Develop dashboards and reports to track KPIs, SLA adherence, and service performance.
  • Analyze trends to identify improvement opportunities and reduce ticket resolution time.


Innovation & Integration

  • Explore and implement new Freshservice features and third-party integrations to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Support initiatives around self-service, knowledge management, and AI-driven support.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • 3–5 years of experience in ITSM roles, with at least 2 years hands-on experience in Freshservice administration and configuration.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL framework and service management principles.
  • Experience with automation, scripting, and API integrations within Freshservice.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Certifications in ITIL, Freshservice, or related platforms are a plus.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

5%-15% travel as per business requirements

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

As a Senior Software Engineer you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as an influencer for our technical direction. You will be able to contribute to various initiatives as well as provide feedback through code reviews and pairing. We are especially excited about you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or if you are passionate about our mission of sustainability in creating a circular economy for high-end goods.


- Develop using interesting technologies -- Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB - Have input into design and architectural decisions that will shape the future of our software systems - Mentor, actively participate in code reviews, and pair up with a team member to work together on features - Act as a strong partner to product and engineering management


✅ Skills/Experience - Minimum Requirements:

- 7+ years of web application development experience with a track record of successfully shipping consumer or business facing products - Experience in writing reliable and maintainable code, reusable components and component libraries that may be used by many other engineers

- Experience with any of Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, NextJs, or another programming language

- Passionate about testing practices and continuous improvement

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods


Preferred Requirements: - Experience with Javascript, HTML, CSS, and React - Experience with GraphQL - Experience building microservices - Experience building eCommerce platforms - Experience working with a CMS, especially Prismic - Any experience with mobile development for iOS and/or Android


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

As a Senior Software Engineer you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as an influencer for our technical direction. You will be able to contribute to various initiatives as well as provide feedback through code reviews and pairing. We are especially excited about you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or if you are passionate about our mission of sustainability in creating a circular economy for high-end goods.


- Develop using interesting technologies -- Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB - Have input into design and architectural decisions that will shape the future of our software systems - Mentor, actively participate in code reviews, and pair up with a team member to work together on features - Act as a strong partner to product and engineering management


✅ Skills/Experience - Minimum Requirements:

- 7+ years of web application development experience with a track record of successfully shipping consumer or business facing products - Experience in writing reliable and maintainable code, reusable components and component libraries that may be used by many other engineers

- Experience with any of Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, NextJs, or another programming language

- Passionate about testing practices and continuous improvement

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods


Preferred Requirements: - Experience with Javascript, HTML, CSS, and React - Experience with GraphQL - Experience building microservices - Experience building eCommerce platforms - Experience working with a CMS, especially Prismic - Any experience with mobile development for iOS and/or Android


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Node Developer position requires a problem solver who combines experience, knowledge, and independence to tackle complex tasks. This role involves architecting backend systems, implementing features at a rapid pace, and contributing to building a world-class engineering team while maintaining high standards of code quality and innovation.


Key responsibilities:


- Architecting backend systems using best practices.

- Implementing and iterating features strategically.

- Working collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast-paced early-stage startup environment.

- Designing, extending, and implementing APIs.

- Maintaining high engineering quality standards through code reviews, unit tests, and analytics.

- Improving engineering productivity through automation and tool development.

- Defining engineering processes for product launches and releases.

- Helping grow the engineering team by conducting technical interviews.


Requirements:


- Node.js Experience: 5+ years of experience in Node development.

- Database Skills: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

- Architecture Knowledge: Experience with microservices and cloud platforms.

- Algorithm Proficiency: Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Infrastructure Understanding: IT infrastructure knowledge.

- Agile Methodology: Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Best Practices: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, clean code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns: Knowledge of software design patterns.

- Application Development: Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Testing & Deployment: Experience in automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.

- Version Control: Strong experience with version control systems.

- Language Skills: Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Especialista de Redes
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Sólida experiência em ambientes de monitoramento e sustentação de tecnologia;
  • Expertise em redes Cisco R&S;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de monitoramento de rede;
  • Habilidade com ferramentas como Zabbix, Grafana e Ansible;
  • Capacidade de seguir padrões, políticas e procedimentos técnicos;
  • Inglês intermediário, com boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Experiência comprovada em redes Cisco;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiencia com Cisco;
  • Desejável: Certificação CCNP;


O que te oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Data Enginner w/ Databricks  (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Engineer;
  • At least 3 years of professional experience with Databricks and Python;
  • Fluent in both spoken and written English - (B2 or above - Mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase?

We are waiting for you!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Senior Clinical Research Associate (CRA) — Epilepsy Study (Phase II/III)


I’m currently looking for experienced Senior CRAs to join an exciting Phase II/III Epilepsy Study with one of my key clients. This is a 1.0 FTE contract role supporting 6–8 sites across the Central and Eastern U.S. — and it’s available for an immediate start .


If you’re someone who thrives in neurology studies and enjoys working on impactful research, this could be a great fit for you.


Here’s what you need to know:

  • Contract: 12 months, with a strong chance of renewal based on performance (my current CRAs with this client have all been extended!)
  • Experience: At least 5+ years of independent monitoring
  • Travel: Regular site visits across Central and Eastern U.S.
  • Therapeutic Area: Neurology , with prior seizure trial experience being strongly desired.


This sponsor truly values quality and consistency, and you’d be joining a talented team dedicated to advancing care for patients with seizure disorders.


The application window is short , so if this sounds like something you’d like to explore, let’s set up a quick chat today!

title: Senior Back-End Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software experience, including API and domain model design as well as JavaScript and Node.js development, to join our U.S. client's Platform Engineering team. The ideal candidate will design, build, and deliver high-quality, performant back-end services that power a world-class compliance and trust automation platform. The Platform Engineering team focuses on core components, such as authentication, RBAC, data architecture, and back-end infrastructure, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability across the product suite.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our clients take the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy to a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their effectiveness against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Build services and APIs in JavaScript and Node.js
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles and implement them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 5+ years of back-end software development experience designing APIs and domain models with knowledge of JavaScript and Node.js
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols, such as OAuth, OIDC, and SAML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with debugging and performance testing
  • A focus on delivering value and being action-oriented
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, or related field


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter. Think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual, no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,
  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.


What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.


Why Join Us? 

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.


How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.


Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a Nashville-based public relations company that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands around the world.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth.

We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.

Role

The Marketing Automation & Systems Assistant will serve as the technical backbone of Publicity For Good's marketing operations, responsible for building, managing, and optimizing automated marketing systems, funnels, and advertising campaigns. This position ensures seamless execution of marketing initiatives through expert management of GoHighLevel (GHL), ad platforms, email automation, and integrated marketing technologies. The ideal candidate is both technically proficient and strategically minded, capable of translating marketing objectives into automated systems that drive measurable growth while maintaining PFG's client-focused, purpose-driven approach.

Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and optimize complete marketing funnels in GoHighLevel including landing pages, workflows, automations, and email/SMS campaigns for lead nurturing and product launches
  • Integrate GHL with third-party tools and implement multi-channel campaigns across email, SMS, and social platforms
  • Set up, launch, and monitor paid advertising campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, and LinkedIn with proper audience targeting and budget management
  • Monitor ad performance metrics, conduct A/B testing, and make data-driven optimization recommendations to improve campaign ROI
  • Set up conversion tracking, pixels, and analytics across all marketing platforms and maintain marketing technology stack
  • Track key marketing metrics and identify optimization opportunities from campaign data
  • Document marketing processes, SOPs, and system configurations while ensuring data hygiene across all systems
  • Collaborate with marketing team to translate strategies into technical execution and coordinate with creative team on asset specifications
  • Provide technical guidance to team members on marketing systems and proactively flag performance issues or opportunities to leadership
Results
  • Marketing funnels and automation sequences are built, tested, and launched on schedule with high conversion performance
  • Advertising campaigns are set up accurately, monitored continuously, and optimized for maximum ROI
  • Marketing technology systems operate seamlessly with minimal downtime and optimal integration
  • Campaign performance dashboards are updated daily with accurate, actionable insights
  • Marketing processes are documented and standardized for consistent, scalable execution
  • Team is empowered with efficient marketing systems that reduce manual work and increase campaign effectiveness
  • All marketing campaigns maintain brand standards while achieving measurable business objectives
Requirements
  • Proven experience with CRM systems including advanced workflows, funnel building, and automation setup
  • Hands-on experience managing Facebook/Instagram Ads Manager and Google Ads platforms
  • Proficiency with email marketing automation tools and marketing integrations 
  • Strong understanding of conversion tracking, pixels, analytics implementation, and campaign performance metrics
  • Knowledge of digital marketing fundamentals: funnel strategy, lead generation, conversion optimization, and A/B testing
  • Experience with analytics platforms
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues across platforms
  • Exceptional organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail and excellent time management across multiple campaigns
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a data-driven, goal-oriented mindset focused on measurable results
  • Proactive self-starter who works independently in remote environments, with strong communication skills and adaptability to new technologies
Remuneration & Rewards
  • Remote independent contractor position
  • Competitive compensation based on performance advancement plan
  • Access to internal and external professional development opportunities
  • Curated library of on-demand professional development resources
  • Quarterly performance reviews with clear career advancement pathways

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno (GIS)
description:
Analisar, planejar e executar desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência trabalhando com serviços restfull e microserviços;
  • Conhecimentos em html5, CSS3, node.js, angular, vue e react;
  • Conhecimentos em Python;
  • Conhecimentos em SQL e Análise de Dados;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Capacidade de realizar testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando todas as linguagens suportadas na plataforma ArcGIS.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.


Responsabilidades:

  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, através da conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido, junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Escrever o plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

title: IT Application Portfolio Management (APM) Engineer
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


Role: IT APM Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate

Duration: 12+ Months


We are seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Application Portfolio Management (APM) Engineer to support our enterprise architecture and application rationalization efforts using LeanIX. This role is critical in capturing, analyzing, and maintaining application metadata to assess current technology usage, align future business requirements, and guide decisions on modernization, consolidation, or new application development. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote India or Brazil.


Why This Role Matters:

This role directly supports our enterprise-wide transformation by enabling smarter technology investments, reducing redundancy, and aligning IT capabilities with business strategy. You’ll play a key role in shaping our future application landscape.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

LeanIX Data Stewardship

  • Populate and maintain accurate application data within LeanIX, including ownership, lifecycle, business capabilities, and technical attributes.
  • Ensure completeness and consistency of metadata across the application portfolio.


Application Rationalization

  • Evaluate applications for business value (e.g., strategic alignment, user impact, cost efficiency).
  • Assess technical value (e.g., scalability, integration readiness, security posture, supportability).
  • Identify candidates for retirement, consolidation, or modernization.


Technology Mapping & Future Planning

  • Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to map future business requirements to existing technologies.
  • Support decision-making on whether to enhance current platforms or build new applications.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with application owners, enterprise architects, and business analysts to gather insights and validate data.
  • Facilitate workshops and reviews to ensure alignment on application strategy and lifecycle decisions.


Reporting & Insights

  • Generate dashboards and reports from LeanIX to support executive decision-making.
  • Provide insights into portfolio health, redundancy, risk, and optimization opportunities.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • 3+ years of experience in application portfolio management, enterprise architecture, or IT asset management.
  • Hands-on experience with LeanIX or similar APM tools.
  • Strong understanding of application lifecycle, business capability modeling, and technology stack analysis.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, BIZBOK) is required.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-15% travel as per business requirements.
